channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli attacks kill several in Lebanon, with health workers targeted
item.description: More than 400 people have been killed since the ceasefire came into effect in mid-April.

item.title: India is being left to die in the heat
item.description: Modi denied climate change for years. Now, as heat deaths mount, his government offers branding instead of protection.

item.title: Iran’s enriched uranium stockpile: Can it be safely transferred?
item.description: Reports say Khamenei issued a directive that Iran's enriched uranium should not be sent abroad.

item.title: Tuchel leaves Palmer and Foden out of England’s 2026 World Cup squad
item.description: Real Madrid's Trent Alexander-Arnold also left out, while Saudi-based Al-Ahli striker Ivan Toney the surprise inclusion.

item.title: US navy chief says $14bn arms sale to Taiwan paused due to Iran war
item.description: Hung Cao told a Senate hearing they were "doing a pause" on the sale to make sure they had munitions for the Iran war.

item.title: Iran steps up claim to control Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran publishes a map claiming "armed forces oversight" across more than 22,000 sq km of the waterway.

item.title: Gaza flotilla activists deported from Israel as backlash over treatment grows
item.description: A video showing a far-right Israeli minister taunting activists who were kneeling with their hands tied behind their backs has been widely condemned.

item.title: Air France and Airbus found guilty of manslaughter over 2009 plane crash
item.description: The companies were found guilty by a French court over an air disaster which killed 228 people.
